title: 3D Anatomical & Scientific Visualization Rig - Schistocerca Gregaria
shortDescription: High-resolution 3D digital sculpture and procedural material study created in Blender & Unreal Engine 5, anchoring the visual identity of the UN-Portfolio cover and technical training suites.
mandateChallenge: Bridge scientific entomological accuracy with striking editorial design so technical UN manuals and animations command immediate visual authority.
executionCraft: Sculpted and retopologized in Blender, shaded with subsurface scattering and studio rim lighting, and integrated into print layouts and motion sequences.
impactMetric: Featured Cover Artifact · Print & Motion Pipeline
